title: Charm Of Sealing
description: This mod adds a way to seal your stats when you become too powerful but don't want to sacrifice the other benefits of your gear.
body:
# Introducing the Charm Of Sealing
There are times when my powerfully modded gear has an absurd step height or speed that interrupts me, but the gear is too good to sacrifice. Now you can compromise by sealing the stats of your choice!

There is built-in compatibility for Curios, Apotheosis, and Iron's Spells & Spellbooks if you run heavily modded packs, though none of these are required.

**I hope you enjoy and God bless, my friends!**

**Jesus loves you and that matters, eternal life is no joke**
